pr.title: Fix ip-address classification vulnerabilities in the locked dependency
pr.body:
Post-merge CI for PR469 now rejects the existing ip-address 10.3.1 lock entry for GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q and GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc. Update only that compatible transitive dependency to 10.7.2; the security threshold, allowlist, dependency ranges and unrelated lock entries are unchanged.

Validation: the exact repository audit-ci configuration passes. Four local address cases reproduce the vulnerable behavior on 10.3.1 and pass on 10.7.2 (IPv6 link-local and local-use NAT64); two public-address controls remain public. Only version, resolved URL and integrity differ in package-lock.json. No deployment was manually triggered. Independent approval and current-head hosted checks are required before merge.

Sources: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rpw4-54j3-4h4q and https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2vr4-cq9g-pvrc.
